summary: In Methow Valley, Washington, Fire Adapted Methow Neighborhood Ambassador Program is an implementation initiative. Neighborhood ambassador program provides education, guidance, resources, and volunteer-led engagement to motivate fire-adaptation strategies. The case addresses wildfire risk and smoke/evacuation preparedness. Available materials report education, guidance, resources, reported relationship, network building, and planned WiRē study. The available materials do not identify an independent measured outcome.
